items.title: Russia’s largest bank Sberbank plans crypto trading infrastructure by December
items.description: New regulations for crypto trading, custody, and settlement in Russia take effect Sept. 1, with requirements for licensed intermediaries applying from July 2027.

items.title: North Korea arrests hackers accused of laundering stolen funds from country's bank via crypto
items.description: The group allegedly breached Central Bank systems, converted crypto to cash via Chinese brokers, and used small transfers to evade detection.

items.title: Democratizing weather derivatives through tokenization could be crypto's most important real-world use case
items.description: Main Street, which faces the most significant climate-related financial risk, currently lacks an avenue to hedge weather-related risks, argues CoinDesk’s Omkar Godbole.

items.title: Robinhood Chain's real-world assets jump fivefold as tokenized stocks start trading in bigger size
items.description: The chain built to put equities onchain has tripled in size since mid-July, and a dozen tokenized stocks are now each clearing $500,000 a day. Real-world assets are growing fast, though memecoins and stablecoins still dominate the chain.

items.title: Senate Dems should accept the victory they won on Trump's crypto limits: White House
items.description: U.S. Senate Democrats got President Donald Trump to accept potential limits on his lucrative crypto dealings, but they say the Clarity Act's restrictions aren't enough.

items.title: Sam Altman-backed World Network secures $52.5 million in fresh funding to fight online AI deepfakes
items.description: The project is moving away from basic network expansion to focus entirely on integrating its biometric screening devices across enterprise software suites.

items.title: Institutional crypto trading platform LMAX is exploring sale, IPO
items.description: LMAX is working with Morgan Stanley and investment bank KBW to assess its options, which could lead to a sale or a public offering.

items.title: Saylor and team overhaul Strategy's bitcoin metrics as bear market persists
items.description: New framework gives common shareholders a clearer view of net bitcoin exposure after preferred stock and convertible debt obligations

items.title: Binance ‘red teams’ its own staff every month to keep hackers out
items.description: Binance regularly tests its employees for security hygiene, with social engineering becoming a major source of industry breaches.

items.title: Robinhood in talks with Crypto.com over prediction markets: WSJ
items.description: While prediction market companies in the US continue to face legal battles between state and federal authorities, Robinhood is reportedly considering expanding its services.

items.title: Bitcoin advocacy group to join US State Department’s ‘digital freedom’ program
items.description: The Bitcoin Policy Institute and three partner organizations will be able to send employees to work alongside State Department officials to address issues including digital freedom.

items.title: Wise to resubmit US charter application under GENIUS Act
items.description: The OCC denied the UK company’s application this week citing AML/CFT risks, despite approving similar charters for digital asset companies in the last year.

items.title: North Korea arrests bank hacking ring tied to crypto laundering: Report
items.description: Daily NK reported that North Korea arrested former state cyber operators accused of hacking two state banks and laundering funds through crypto.

items.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today

items.title: Fidelity joins push for Senate passage of CLARITY Act
items.description: Fidelity called on the US Senate to pass the CLARITY Act, joining industry groups and crypto firms pushing for market structure legislation.

items.title: Dango’s perp DEX taps out nearly 4 months after launch
items.description: Dango will close its network on Aug. 13, joining BitMEX, Odos and Satori Finance in a wave of recent crypto shutdowns.

items.title: Imax 70 mm screenings become the biggest star for Christopher Nolan’s ‘The Odyssey’
items.description: Moviegoers are traveling, lining up and paying premiums to see Christopher Nolan’s ‘The Odyssey’ in scarce Imax 70 mm screenings.

items.title: From Silicon Valley to DC, the tech world is suddenly obsessed with one concept in AI: Distillation
items.description: Distillation has long been a topic for AI wonks, but it's become a hot-button issue of late as techies and lawmakers debate how it should be regulated.

items.title: Analysis: A powerful new coalition of AI skeptics is coalescing right in Trump's blind spot
items.description: Evangelicals, labor unions and anti-AI-data-center activists are part of a groundswell worrying about how fast technology is changing.

items.title: Trump sued hours after new tariffs take effect, as experts say they may not hold up
items.description: President Donald Trump has renewed a flurry of tariffs, including slapping 25% duties on Brazilian imports and vowing 50% tariffs on goods from Canada.

items.title: Logistics giants are racing to keep up with healthcare boom as GLP-1s highlight need for cold storage
items.description: Shipping and logistics companies are tapping into the growing market of healthcare as cold chain and temperature-controlled facilities become more crucial.

items.title: Nvidia locks down memory supply from SK Hynix as part of $500 billion AI deal
items.description: Nvidia is aggressively securing supply of high-bandwidth memory, an essential component for its GPUs and systems.

items.title: Buffett favors an estate tax, but like virtually all billionaires, he won't be paying it
items.description: Warren Buffett believes he and other very wealthy Americans are under-taxed but by giving his fortune to charity, he won't be paying billions in potential levies to the government.

items.title: Does crypto make your portfolio less risky? Only if you do it right, experts say
items.description: There's a right way and a wrong way to use cryptocurrencies such as bitcoin for portfolio diversification, financial advisors and market analysts said.
